//! The names port, implemented with memory.

use crate::outbound::names::errors::NamesError;
use crate::outbound::names::interface::NamesPort;
use crate::outbound::names::types::{Asked, Greeting};

/// The memory names adapter.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub(crate) struct NamesMemoryAdapter;

impl NamesPort for NamesMemoryAdapter {
    fn stored(&self, asked: &Asked) -> Result<Greeting, NamesError> {
        if asked.0 == "Ada" {
            return Ok(Greeting("hello, Ada"));
        }
        Err(NamesError::Missing)
    }
}
